## Hotel AGAVA
https://hotelagava.ge/en/
Hotel Agava — a comfortable hotel in Tbilisi on Beliashvili Street, Dighomi. Family and jacuzzi rooms, free parking, Wi-Fi and 24/7 reception. Book direct.
- The hotel: 21 rooms in 8 types · Dighomi, 161 Akaki Beliashvili St · 4.8 on Google
- Rooms: 120–400 GEL per night
- Free: Wi-Fi · parking in the courtyard, 11 spaces · a lift to all four floors · reception open 24 hours
- Paid extras: breakfast 30 GEL (08:00–11:00) · transfer 70/50 GEL · laundry 10 GEL (12 hours)
- House rules: check-in from 13:00, check-out by 12:00 · payment on site, in cash only

Q&A:
- What are the check-in and check-out times? — Check-in from 13:00, check-out by 12:00. Early check-in or late check-out is possible by prior arrangement, subject to availability.
- How do I pay? — Payment is made on site at the hotel — in cash only — cards are not accepted. No prepayment is required for online booking.
- What is the cancellation policy? — Free cancellation up to 24 hours before arrival — call us or message us on WhatsApp with your booking number.
- Is there parking? — Yes, the hotel has free, secure parking for guests — right in the courtyard.
- Is breakfast included? — Breakfast is available as an extra — with a varied menu every morning. Mention it in your booking comment or arrange it with reception.
- Are pets allowed? — Please contact us in advance about pets — we consider each case individually.

## Comfortable hotel rooms in Tbilisi
https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/
Explore the comfortable rooms at Hotel Agava in Tbilisi — standard, family and jacuzzi suites for 2–5 guests. See what is included and book direct.

Q&A:
- How many rooms does the hotel have? — Hotel Agava has 21 rooms — standard rooms, lux and superlux, two jacuzzi suites and family rooms for 3–5 guests.
- Which room is the largest? — The two-bedroom suite, which sleeps five and consists of two separate rooms. For two guests the superlux is the most spacious.
- What is included in the room rate? — The rate covers accommodation, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, a private bathroom and daily housekeeping. Breakfast is not included in the room rate — you order it separately. Add a note to your booking or arrange it with reception on arrival.
- What are the check-in and check-out times? — Check-in from 13:00, check-out until 12:00. Early check-in or late check-out can be arranged in advance, subject to availability.
- How do I pay? — Payment is taken at the hotel — in cash only; cards are not accepted. No prepayment is required for an online booking.
- Can I smoke? — Smoking is not allowed in the rooms. You can smoke outside, in the covered part of the courtyard. There is no fine.
- Can an extra bed be added? — No. Neither an extra bed nor a baby cot is added in any room. Choose the room by the number of guests — there are rooms for three, four and five.
- Do children cost extra? — No. The price is per room, not per person — what matters is that the number of guests does not exceed the room's capacity. Breakfast is ordered separately, at 30 GEL per guest.

## Hotel Agava amenities and comforts
https://hotelagava.ge/en/amenities/
Hotel Agava amenities: free secure parking, Wi-Fi, buffet breakfast, airport transfer, laundry, a lift to all four floors and 24/7 reception. Dighomi,…
- Free: Wi-Fi · parking in the courtyard, 11 spaces · a lift to all four floors · reception open 24 hours
- Paid extras: breakfast 30 GEL (08:00–11:00) · transfer 70/50 GEL · laundry 10 GEL (12 hours)
- House rules: check-in from 13:00, check-out by 12:00 · payment on site, in cash only
- What there is not: no restaurant, pool, spa, gym, conference room, luggage room or currency exchange

Q&A:
- Does the hotel have a lift? — Yes. The hotel has four floors and the lift serves all of them.
- Is parking free? — Yes, free for hotel guests. There are 11 spaces in the yard, so please tell us in advance if you are arriving by car.
- Is the Wi-Fi charged? — No, Wi-Fi is free and works in every room and all common areas, with no time or device limit.
- Is breakfast included in the room rate? — No. Breakfast is ordered separately at 30 GEL per guest — a buffet served 08:00 to 11:00.
- Is there a restaurant or a pool? — No. The hotel has no full-menu restaurant, swimming pool, spa or gym.
- Can I leave my bags after check-out? — Unfortunately not — the hotel has no luggage room. If you are staying in the city that day, a late check-out is the better option.
- How much is the airport transfer? — From the airport to the hotel 70 GEL, from the hotel to the airport 50 GEL. The price is per car, with four seats; the journey takes 30–40 minutes.
- Can I pay by card? — No, payment is made on site, in cash only.
- How much is breakfast? — 30 GEL per guest, buffet from 08:00 to 11:00. Not included in the room price.
- What time are check-in and check-out? — Check-in from 13:00, check-out by 12:00. Early check-in and late check-out are charged.
- How much is laundry? — 10 GEL per item, ready in 12 hours.
- Is there a conference room? — No. The hotel has no conference room or business centre.
- Can I smoke? — Smoking is not allowed in the rooms. You can smoke outside, in the covered part of the courtyard. There is no fine.

- Is the Wi-Fi good enough for video calls? — Wi-Fi is free and works in every room with no limits. The speed varies with the time of day and how busy the hotel is — if you have video calls, ask when you book and we will suggest a suitable room.
- Can I check in late at night? — Yes. Reception is staffed 24 hours with a real person overnight, so you can check in at any hour.
- Can I pay by card? — No, the hotel is settled in cash only. If you pay on a company card or need documentation, call +995 597 12 12 12 before booking.
- How far is the airport? — 30 to 40 minutes. The transfer is 70 GEL from the airport and 50 GEL back — per car, with four seats.

## Hotel breakfast — the buffet
https://hotelagava.ge/en/services/breakfast/
Breakfast at Hotel Agava is a buffet served 08:00-11:00 for 30 GEL per guest. Eggs, cheeses, pastries, vegetables, seasonal fruit, coffee and tea.

Q&A:
- How much does breakfast cost? — Breakfast is 30 GEL per guest. Coffee, tea and juice are included in that price.
- Is breakfast included in the room rate? — No. Breakfast is charged separately and ordered either when you book or at reception after you arrive.
- Is there a discount for children? — No. There is no children's discount and no age below which breakfast is free — it is 30 GEL for every guest.
- What time is breakfast? — Breakfast is served from 08:00 to 11:00 in the hotel dining room.
- I have an early flight — can I eat earlier? — Unfortunately not. Breakfast opens at 08:00 and we cannot serve before that, and we do not prepare a packed option either.
- Is there a vegetarian option? — Yes. The buffet includes salads, several kinds of cheese, eggs, vegetables, olives, yoghurt, pastries, fruit and cereal.
- Is it a buffet or served to the table? — It is a buffet — you help yourself, with no limit on how much you take.

## Hotel laundry service — Tbilisi
https://hotelagava.ge/en/services/laundry/
Laundry at Hotel Agava — 10 GEL per item, ready in 12 hours. Drop it at reception at any hour. 161 Beliashvili St, Dighomi, Tbilisi.

Q&A:
- How much does laundry cost? — 10 GEL per item. It is priced per item rather than by weight, so you know the total in advance.
- How long does it take? — 12 hours. Clothes handed in during the morning are back the same evening; anything given in at night is ready the next morning.
- How do I arrange it? — There is nothing to book — hand your things in at reception. Reception is staffed 24 hours, so there is no cut-off time.
- What if I need something urgently? — Say so when you hand it in and tell reception when you need it. They will tell you whether it fits your timing.
- Do you take every kind of item? — Individual pieces — a coat, a suit, or a delicate fabric — are checked case by case. Show the item at reception and they will tell you straight away.

## Free hotel parking — Tbilisi, Dighomi
https://hotelagava.ge/en/services/parking/
Hotel Agava has 11 parking spaces in its own yard, free for hotel guests, with cameras and night security. Open 24 hours. 161 Beliashvili St, Dighomi.

Q&A:
- Is parking free? — Yes, parking is completely free for hotel guests. It is not a public car park — we do not take vehicles from outside.
- How many spaces are there? — There are 11 spaces in the hotel yard. Since the hotel has 21 rooms, please tell us in advance if you are arriving by car.
- Do I need to reserve a space? — It is a good idea. Add a note to your booking saying you are driving, or call +995 597 12 12 12.
- Will an SUV or minibus fit? — Yes. The parking is an open yard, so there is no height restriction. A tour coach can be parked too — call ahead in that case.
- Can I drive in at night? — Yes. The gate is not locked and the yard is accessible 24 hours. There is also a member of staff on reception all night.
- Is the yard fenced? — No, the yard is not fenced and the gate is not locked at night. It is, however, covered by cameras, lit after dark and watched by security staff.
- Is there an EV charger? — No, the hotel does not have an electric vehicle charger.

## 24/7 reception — check in at any hour
https://hotelagava.ge/en/services/reception/
Reception at Hotel Agava is staffed 24 hours — a real person overnight, not a bell. Check-in from 13:00, check-out by 12:00.

Q&A:
- I am arriving at night — can I still check in? — Yes. Reception is staffed 24 hours with a real person on the desk overnight, so you can check in at any hour.
- What are the check-in and check-out times? — Check-in is from 13:00 and check-out is by 12:00.
- Can I have an early check-in or late check-out? — Both are possible, but they are charged and depend on how full the hotel is that day. Call +995 597 12 12 12 for the exact amount.
- Can I leave my bags after check-out? — Unfortunately not — the hotel does not have a luggage room. If you are staying in the city that day, a late check-out is the better option.
- What languages do the staff speak? — Georgian, English, Russian and Turkish.
- Can I pay by card? — No, the hotel is settled in cash only. There is no currency exchange service either.
- Will reception help me book a taxi or a tour? — Yes. Reception is happy to call a taxi and to help you book tours or restaurants.
- Can I smoke? — Smoking is not allowed in the rooms. You can smoke outside, in the covered part of the courtyard. There is no fine.

## Airport transfer — Tbilisi
https://hotelagava.ge/en/services/transfer/
Transfer between Tbilisi airport and Hotel Agava — 70 GEL on arrival, 50 GEL to the airport. Price is per car, up to four people.

Q&A:
- How much is the airport transfer? — 70 GEL from the airport to the hotel and 50 GEL from the hotel to the airport. The price is per car, not per person.
- How many people fit? — The car seats four. The fare is the same whether one of you travels or four.
- Do you have a child seat? — No, we do not have a child seat. Please plan around that if you are travelling with a small child.
- How far in advance should I book? — One or two days ahead. Call +995 597 12 12 12 with your flight number, date, time and number of passengers.
- Where does the driver meet me? — In the arrivals hall. If your flight is delayed, the driver waits.
- Do you run transfers for night flights? — Yes, and the price does not change — the night rate is the same as the daytime one.
- Do you drive to Kutaisi airport? — No. The transfer covers Tbilisi International Airport only. We do not drive to the railway station either.
- Can I pay by card? — No, the transfer is paid in cash only.
- How long is the drive to the airport? — About 30 to 40 minutes, depending on traffic.

## Free Wi-Fi in the hotel — Tbilisi
https://hotelagava.ge/en/services/wifi/
Free Wi-Fi at Hotel Agava — in every room and all common areas, with no extra charge, no time limit and no device limit. Password at reception.

Q&A:
- Is the Wi-Fi free? — Yes, completely free and included in the room rate. There is no additional or daily charge.
- Does it work in every room? — Yes. The network covers all rooms and the common areas, including the dining room.
- How do I get the password? — Reception gives it to you at check-in. There is no registration form and no SMS code.
- How many devices can I connect? — There is no limit — phone, laptop and tablet at the same time is fine.
- Is it good enough for remote work? — The speed varies with the time of day and how busy the hotel is. If work is the main point of your trip, ask when you book and reception will tell you which rooms are better in that respect.
